mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the average forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC drops below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 2.3 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which translates into higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 2300.0, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 98.2 index points indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals deteriorating corporate output and future earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 98.2, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 2.0% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals inflationary pressures that prompt central bank hawkishness, leading to higher real rates and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 2.0 and FEDFUNDS ≤ 4.5 fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 347,000 million dollars, combined with rising housing starts, indicates strong aggregate demand that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS > 347000 and HOUST > 2270 fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment and decline in unemployment rate signals labor market tightening that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises >100k and UNRATE falls >0.2pp, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP growth above 3.0% annualized, as measured by GDPC1, signals strong economic momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of quarters where GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0%, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
